title: AffineEtaleFiniteDiagramDescent
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : I^op → Scheme a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, and c a limiting cone. Let v_i : FullAffineEtale(D_i) → FullAffineEtale(c.pt) and natural transformations q_i to the underlying-scheme functor satisfy the q-pullback squares over c_i [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site, def-pc-fibre-product]. For any n : N, target A, affine étale sources B_a indexed by Fin n, and arrows f_a : B_a → A over c.pt, there are a common stage i, affine étale objects Ai and Bi_a, arrows fi_a, and isomorphisms t : v_i(Ai) ≅ A and s_a : v_i(Bi_a) ≅ B_a, with v_i(fi_a) ≫ t.hom = s_a.hom ≫ f_a. No covering or surjectivity is assumed or concluded. The empty source family is allowed.

proof.text: Descend each affine étale object: the limit is qcqs by affine projections; the structure morphism is finitely presented; apply 01ZM, identify the base-change-tail limit by 01YZ, descend affineness by 01Z6 and étaleness by 07RP. Base change preserves both properties.

Take a common upper bound for the target and finitely many sources; n = 0 still retains the target. The q-pullback squares identify v-images with the original objects. Descend the conjugated arrows by 01ZM(2), then take a common later stage. Pullback uniqueness and naturality of q yield the displayed equations.

proof_origin.place: Adaptation of 0EYL to chosen functors; source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EYL and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07RR on 2026-10-12
